    SELECT 
        ba.fundlink,
        SUM(ba.allocationpct) AS total_bond_alloc,
        SUM(CASE WHEN br.creditmark IN ('us_government', 'aaa', 'aa') THEN ba.allocationpct ELSE 0 END) AS high_quality_alloc
    FROM bond_allocations ba

),

    SELECT 
        fundlink,
        CASE WHEN total_bond_alloc > 0 THEN high_quality_alloc / total_bond_alloc ELSE 0 END AS hq_ratio,
